CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_receptionist(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_context_valid(_user_id)
    OR (
      NOT public.finance_training_is_restricted(_user_id)
      AND public.has_role(_user_id, 'employee')
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.employees e
        WHERE e.user_id = _user_id AND e.active AND e.position = 'receptionist'
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_transaction_payment(_transaction_id uuid, _amount numeric, _method text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.record_transaction_payment(
    _transaction_id, _amount, _method, gen_random_uuid(), NULL::uuid
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_transaction_payment(_transaction_id uuid, _amount numeric, _method text, _idempotency_key uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.record_transaction_payment(
    _transaction_id, _amount, _method, _idempotency_key, NULL::uuid
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_commission_at(_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(mode text, rate numeric, per_room_amount numeric, rounding_rule text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT c.mode, c.rate, c.per_room_amount, c.rounding_rule
  FROM public.finance_commission_configs c
  WHERE c.effective_from <= _at
  ORDER BY c.effective_from DESC, c.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_is_booking_operator(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_context_valid(_user_id)
    OR (
      NOT public.finance_training_is_restricted(_user_id)
      AND (
        public.has_role(_user_id, 'owner')
        OR public.is_receptionist(_user_id)
        OR public.has_employee_position(
          _user_id, ARRAY['supervisor'::public.employee_position]
        )
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_is_owner_or_supervisor(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_context_valid(_user_id)
    OR (
      NOT public.finance_training_is_restricted(_user_id)
      AND (
        public.has_role(_user_id, 'owner')
        OR public.has_employee_position(
          _user_id, ARRAY['supervisor'::public.employee_position]
        )
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_finance_session_summary(_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  s public.finance_cash_sessions;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF public.finance_training_is_restricted(auth.uid())
     AND NOT public.finance_training_context_matches_session(auth.uid(), _session_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Peserta Training hanya dapat melihat sesi kas penanggung jawab';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO s
  FROM public.finance_cash_sessions
  WHERE id = _session_id;

  IF NOT FOUND
     OR (
       s.opened_by <> auth.uid()
       AND NOT public.finance_is_owner_or_supervisor(auth.uid())
       AND NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'owner')
       AND NOT public.finance_training_context_matches_session(auth.uid(), _session_id)
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Akses sesi ditolak';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'opening_cash', s.opening_cash,
    -- Preserve the deployed Finance contract: cash-only expected balance
    -- can be negative; QRIS/Transfer must not inflate physical cash.
    'expected_cash', s.opening_cash
      + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.payments
                  WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id AND method = 'Cash'), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.finance_expenses
                  WHERE session_id = _session_id AND method = 'CASH'), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.finance_refunds
                  WHERE source_session_id = _session_id AND refund_method = 'CASH'), 0),
    'payments_total', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.payments WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id), 0),
    'cash', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.payments WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id AND method = 'Cash'), 0),
    'qris', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.payments WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id AND method = 'QRIS'), 0),
    'transfer', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.payments WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id AND method = 'Transfer'), 0),
    'commission',
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(commission_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE cash_session_id = _session_id), 0)
      + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.commission_delta)
                  FROM public.finance_refund_allocations a
                  JOIN public.payments p ON p.id = a.payment_id
                  WHERE p.cash_session_id = _session_id), 0),
    'expenses', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.finance_expenses WHERE session_id = _session_id), 0),
    'refunds', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM public.finance_refunds WHERE source_session_id = _session_id), 0),
    'status', s.status,
    'snapshot', s.closing_snapshot
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_valid(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_context_assignment(
    _user_id,
    NULLIF(current_setting('app.finance_training_session_id', true), '')::uuid
  ) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_assignment(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT a.id
  FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
  WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND public.finance_training_session_is_valid(_user_id, _session_id)
  ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_context_matches_session(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT _session_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.finance_training_session_id', true), '')::uuid = _session_id
    AND public.finance_training_context_assignment(_user_id, _session_id) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_current_user_is_restricted()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_is_restricted(auth.uid());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_current_user_can_read_session(_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.finance_training_session_is_valid(auth.uid(), _session_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_assignment_for(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, trainee_user_id uuid, supervisor_user_id uuid, starts_on date, ends_on date, status text, label text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT a.id, a.trainee_user_id, a.supervisor_user_id,
         a.starts_on, a.ends_on, a.status, a.label
  FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
  WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
  ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_is_restricted(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT a.status <> 'PASSED'
      FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
      WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
      ORDER BY a.starts_on DESC, a.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_training_session_is_valid(_user_id uuid, _session_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.finance_training_assignments a
    JOIN public.finance_cash_sessions s
      ON s.id = _session_id
     AND s.opened_by = a.supervisor_user_id
     AND s.status = 'OPEN'
    WHERE a.trainee_user_id = _user_id
      AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date BETWEEN a.starts_on AND a.ends_on)
      AND (
        public.has_role(a.supervisor_user_id, 'owner')
        OR public.has_employee_position(
          a.supervisor_user_id,
          ARRAY['supervisor'::public.employee_position]
        )
      )
  );
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER finance_final_session_guard_trigger BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_cash_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_final_session_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER finance_training_session_guard_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_cash_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_training_session_guard()

CREATE TRIGGER finance_training_handoffs_guard_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_drawer_handoffs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_training_forbidden_finance_mutation_guard()

CREATE TRIGGER finance_training_allocations_guard_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_session_allocations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_training_forbidden_finance_mutation_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER finance_prepare_payment_trigger BEFORE INSERT ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_prepare_payment()
CREATE TRIGGER finance_training_payments_audit_trigger AFTER INSERT ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_training_audit_row()
CREATE TRIGGER finance_training_payments_guard_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_training_session_row_guard()

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_payment_batch_idempotency_pkey ON public.finance_payment_batch_idempotency USING btree (request_idempotency_key)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_pkey ON public.payments USING btree (id)
